jobs.description:
Air Cargo Belgium (ACB) is the official representative of the air cargo community at Brussels Airport Cargo. With over 
170 member companies, we bring together airlines, handlers, forwarders, the airport authority and other stakeholders. We connect, inspire, and 

strengthen the Brussels air cargo community through events, projects and communication.
 

Every year we organize several events that range from content-driven seminars with 20 participants, to bigger networking events like our BBQ with over 700 guests, to more leisurely events like a football tournament. Additionally, we also organize smaller activities like handing out Easter Eggs.
 

With our renewed strategy, we aim to grow from 
3,000 yearly event visitors/participants to over 7,000 in the coming years. This means more events, new ideas on how to best reach our audiences and more strong communication! To make this happen, we’re looking for a 

Community Engagement Coordinator to join our team.
 

Your Role:
As our new Community Engagement Coordinator, you will:
 

Events & Coordination
 
 

• Take the lead in event coordination from A to Z, including the planning, promotion and execution of workshops, seminars, networking events and larger community events. 

• Work closely with our Community Engagement Lead, another coordinator and the wider ACB team to ensure smooth event organization and execution. 

• Occasionally represent ACB, and support the community, at international fairs and events.  

Communication & Content
 
 

• Manage and grow ACB’s social media presence in collaboration with your community engagement colleagues, using tools such as Canva and scheduling tools to create engaging and professional content. 

• Create engaging content for newsletters, social media and online updates, highlighting community news, success stories and relevant information 

• Support the promotion and visibility of ACB’s initiatives, events and community activities.  

Community Engagement & Partnerships
 
 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with our member companies and act as a central point of contact for the community. 

• Contribute to and execute ACB’s community engagement strategy, tailored to the dynamics of the air cargo industry. 

• Gather feedback from community members and translate it into actionable recommendations to continuously improve our community engagement 

• Support the growth of memberships and sponsorships by attracting and engaging relevant stakeholders. 

• Identify and develop partnerships with relevant stakeholders to strengthen the visibility and impact of the ACB community. 

• Monitor engagement metrics and data and report on the results and impact of community engagement initiatives. 

• Act as a visible presence within the community by visiting members to share information, gather feedback, distribute materials and support campaigns or initiatives. 

Your Profile:
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Event Management or Marketing (or similar). 

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience (preferred). 

• Excellent writing and communication skills in English (all external communication). 

• Good knowledge of Dutch (our internal team language). 

• Good knowledge of French, as the role involves direct contact with warehouse staff. 

• Hands-on experience with graphic design (e.g. designing posters with Canva or similar) and a good eye for visual communication. 

• Social media fluency and confidence in creating and managing engaging content across platforms. 

• A people-oriented personality: you enjoy meeting people, building relationships and making new contacts. 

• A proactive attitude: you take initiative, see what needs to be done and act on it. 

• A valid category B driving licence (required for driving a van/minibus for our events). 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Open to learning about aviation and air cargo and connecting with major players in the industry.  

A standard desk job isn’t enough for you — you love variety, dynamism and contact with people.

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Own critical network infrastructure, work with modern technologies and shape the evolution of IT within a stable, people-focused organisation.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating across multiple locations, with a strong focus on service, reliability and digital transformation. Its IT environment supports a broad network of sites and business operations, making availability, security and connectivity essential to its day-to-day activities.

 

As part of a growing IT Infrastructure team, you will join an environment where networking is not simply about keeping systems running: you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work on infrastructure projects and influence how the network evolves.
Network Engineer | The Role
As a Network Engineer, you will take an active role in the operational management and continuous improvement of the organisation's network environment.

• Manage and monitor LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall infrastructure across multiple locations.
• Troubleshoot complex network incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
• Work closely with external technology partners, coordinating their activities and challenging proposed solutions when needed.
• Contribute to network projects, migrations, upgrades and standardisation, while ensuring smooth change management.
• Proactively monitor performance, availability and security, using KPIs and monitoring tools to prevent service degradation and downtime.
• Contribute to automation, security and infrastructure improvements, with opportunities to expand into areas such as cloud, systems or cybersecurity.
Network Engineer | The Profile
We are looking for a technically strong Network Engineer who enjoys ownership, problem-solving and working across a broader infrastructure environment.

• 2+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Systems Engineering or IT Infrastructure.
• Solid knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• Experience with network monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting and change management.
• Familiarity with technologies such as Cisco, Meraki, firewalls, SD-WAN or Network Access Control is a strong plus.
• Interest in automation and scripting using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or APIs.
• Fluent in Dutch or French, professionally proficient in the other national language, with a good command of English.

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager Industial & Technical Solutions
jobs.description:
HQ Antwerp | Coverage: Europe (with potential EMEA expansion)| Business Development Manager| Energy, Oil & Gas

About the Company
Our client is an international technology organization with a strong footprint across Europe. The company designs and delivers advanced software and hardware solutions for complex industrial environments in the oil & gas industry, helping customers operate safely, efficiently and in full regulatory compliance.

 

Your New Role

As Business Development Manager, you are responsible for driving new business growth across Europe. You focus on opening new doors, building long-term commercial relationships and developing a sustainable opportunity pipeline within large, complex organizations.
 
This is a pure new business role with a long-term perspective. You will work on strategic target accounts with lengthy investment cycles, where success depends on trust-building, market insight, and persistence rather than short-term wins.
 
You work closely with the Sales Manager and internal technical teams and operate in a hybrid model combining office-based work, customer visits and international travel.
 
Key Responsibilities

• Identify, approach and develop new customers and new opportunities across European markets
• Map target regions, industries and strategic accounts and define focused action plans
• Establish relationships with key decision-makers within complex organizations
• Build and manage a qualitative sales pipeline through continuous prospecting and follow-up
• Understand customer processes, strategic challenges and long-term investment roadmaps
• Prepare and deliver tailored presentations, demonstrations and commercial proposals
• Collaborate with internal engineering and solution teams to translate business needs into technical solutions
• Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events and conferences
• Maintain structured reporting and pipeline management through CRM tools
• Contribute to long-term growth strategy, forecasting and market development initiatives
 

Your Profile

• At least 3 years of experience in Business Development within a technical or industrial environment
• Educational background in engineering, industrial technology or IT, or equivalent technical-commercial experience
• Experience or affinity with industries such as energy, process industry, industrial systems or infrastructure is a plus
• Demonstrated ability to generate new business, open new accounts and build relationships from the ground up
• Strong hunter mentality with resilience and confidence in approaching senior stakeholders
• Comfortable operating in environments with long sales cycles and high-value investment projects
• Strong communication and presentation skills at executive and technical levels
• Languages: English and Dutch are mandatory; additional European languages (German or French) German is a plusWillingness to travel regularly (short, project-based trips)
